pages.text: An Ender Chest always recognizes its owner, but flowing aether cannot hold that bond. Crystalline fragments provide the final confinement: preserve your presence in the anchor, and the glimmer can follow it to you.

pages.title: A path beyond crystallization
pages.text: Its recipe needs crystalline fragments: first obtain a Nether Star and build its chamber. Place the anchor beside a reservoir and bind your portable receiver.$(br2)It supplies its owner on the move, rather than replacing a workshop's resonance tree. Common same-world delivery is 1K/s with 10% extra spent maintaining the bond.

pages.title: Keep the home glimmer awake
pages.text: Travel should not put your home to sleep. The anchor and its supply must remain active; a world anchor can watch over that small patch of land.$(br2)A Worldbinding Eye extends the bond to other worlds, commonly spending 25% extra. The contents of ordinary Ender Chests remain untouched.
